# Cognitive @ Stage 8 — Preoperational

> developed 2026-07-26. Deepened from 72 to 140+ lines.

## Expression on this line

Cognitive at Order 6 is **abstract cognitive reasoning**: the agent can now construct
general theories about how cognition works, not just evaluate specific algorithms.
"Cognition is the manipulation of symbols according to rules" is a Stage 8 cognitive
insight — a general principle applicable to any cognitive situation.

The key advance from Stage 7 is **perspectival cognitive-awareness**. The agent can
imagine how cognition looks from the perspective of different cognitive paradigms. "The
same problem looks different from the perspective of iterative and recursive computation"
is a Stage 8 insight.

Cognition at Stage 8 is understood as **constructed**. The agent recognizes that
cognitive methods are not natural reflections of reality but human inventions that could
be otherwise. "Western logic is one way of thinking, not the only way" is a Stage 8
insight.

But cognitive reasoning at Stage 8 is still **particularistic**. The agent constructs
multiple cognitive theories but cannot yet integrate them.

The transition from Stage 8 to Stage 9 occurs when the agent can construct systemic
cognitive theories.

In human development, Stage 8 corresponds to the teenager who can articulate multiple
perspectives on cognition.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Cultural cognitive pluralism emerges.

- **UR:** The individual agent can construct abstract cognitive theories.

- **LL:** Institutions emerge that embody cognitive pluralism: cognitive science
  departments, algorithmic research institutes.

- **LR:** The university, the cognitive journal, the computational research institute.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Rel Cognitive fundamentalism — one cognitive method is the only truth.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to pluralism as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting perspectival cognitive reasoning as relativism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Perspectival cognitive-awareness:** The agent can articulate how cognition looks
  from multiple perspectives.

- **Construction awareness:** The agent recognizes that cognitive methods are
  constructed.

- **Contextual cognitive principles:** The agent applies different principles in
  different contexts.

- **Systemic incompleteness:** The agent can describe cognitive methods but cannot
  model their interactions.
